session_selection.time_basis: UTC root first event through root completion.
session_selection.rationale: Workspace-local root 01a0383e plus seven descendants form the benchmark sequence.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Exact d8491d9 solver archive clean CMake build succeeds in network-disabled resource-limited cfd-bench container; numerical runs not repeated.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:1485 onward accepts solve and case input, but solve_case :967–971 writes fixed output/ paths; selected packages lack required metadata partitioner and no restart reader was established.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Most solver implementation resides in 1490-line main.cpp; report and plotting tools are separate, with many raw workspace run variants.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal existing CFD executable invocation established from inspected source; external authorship search not performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:947–953 resolves configured mesh path and case data; no two-filename-only branch established.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS/halo paths exist, but full mesh retained on every rank; main.cpp:1292–1300 calls MPI_Gather only on root and :967–971 opens same CSV on all ranks. Selected np2/4/8 force files are empty; no validated force agreement.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: main.cpp:1292–1300 MPI_Gather only on rank0 risks deadlock, and :967–971 opens same CSVs on all ranks; selected Re200 no shedding and selected M2 laminar fails.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Manifest lists np1/2/4/8 comparisons, but selected np2/4/8 force files for both cases are empty. No valid force agreement or scalability validation established.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source/report tip excludes raw work; many workspace variants and selected metadata lacking revision complicate reproducibility.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: main.cpp:inviscid_flux and viscous_flux implement compressible Euler and Newtonian-Fourier expressions; effective viscous residual is scaled to 1% at :981,1074–1075.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: main.cpp:152 onwards reads CGNS and :388–434 calls METIS for local partitions, but full mesh is loaded on all ranks and retained through solve_case :947–954,1286,1474.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: main.cpp:976–1084 assembles conservative face fluxes and MPI residual norm; viscous contribution scaled 0.01 and steady reconstruction scaled 0.1.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: main.cpp:1064 and :1381 call Rusanov inviscid_flux; no successful independent solution verification and selected M2 case below recomputed target.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: main.cpp:1054–1062 uses configured farfield, slip and no-slip ghosts; gradient computation :585 skips boundary faces, weakening viscous wall behavior.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: main.cpp:978–1016 applies alpha=0.1 reconstruction in steady path; transient :1363–1370 uses cell states. Report.tex:37–38,81–82 discloses alpha but asserts second order/all runs; selected historical run-source linkage unproved.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: main.cpp:991–1012 computes density/pressure limiter in steady path; transient :1363–1370 uses direct states. No verified limiter effectiveness for selected historical runs.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: main.cpp:981,1074–1075 scales viscous flux 0.01; gradient excludes wall faces :585, traction :759–766 is not tangentially projected. Report discloses scaling and Re20 Cd≈0.0006.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Final source :1189 onward contains LU-SGS sweeps, but selected v3 metadata reports diagonal_implicit; report claims all LU-SGS. Root-only gather :1292–1300 also impedes multi-rank steady completion.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Source :1393–1410 forms BDF2 residual with negative time term and tests inner ratio, but source link to selected v3 is unproved; selected forces decay monotonically, metadata claims periodic without valid shedding and no strict target counts.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS/halo paths exist, but full mesh retained on every rank; main.cpp:1292–1300 calls MPI_Gather only on root and :967–971 opens same CSV on all ranks. Selected np2/4/8 force files are empty; no validated force agreement.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Selected v3/v4 metadata omits required partitioner, and Re200 labels monotonic decay statistically periodic. Output writers omit strict inner convergence metadata.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Earlier explicit benchmark validator fails selected outputs on missing partitioner; cfdeval gates check manager records, not CFD validity.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Manifest selects six converged steady cases, one failed and Re200 periodic; Re200 is nonperiodic, M2 inviscid final recomputed ratio -2.862 falls short of its 3-order target.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Selected Re20 Cd≈0.000537 versus expected order2, M080 laminar Cd=-0.0143, and Re200 t200–300 force decay rather than shedding. Report admits cylinder limitations.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted eight-page PDF pp4–5 has M015/M080 Mach and M2 pressure figures with blank plot areas despite colorbars; p8 Re200 force history is startup dominated with no readable late lift/drag. Residual and Cp figures exist.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:37–41 discloses alpha0.1 and viscous scale0.01, :126–142 admits unphysical cylinder forces/no shedding; :81–82 wrongly claims all selected runs LU-SGS versus selected v3 diagonal metadata; MPI force comparisons absent.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Immutable run_manifest selects v3/v4 packages; their metadata lacks git_revision, selected v3 predates final source and reports diagonal rather than LU-SGS. Workspace figure_manifest points generically to output/ rather than selected directories.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Exact d8491d9 clean build passes; solve_case writes fixed output paths and output metadata lacks required partitioner; restart reader not established.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS reading and METIS local partitions implemented, but full mesh per rank remains live throughout iterations, prohibited by TASK.md:227.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Rusanov face residual and MPI norm exist; alpha0.1 reconstruction and 0.01 viscous scaling reduce consistency, and boundary faces are excluded from gradient calculation.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: main.cpp:978–1016 applies reconstruction scaled alpha=0.1 in steady path, leaving a first-order truncation term; transient :1363–1370 uses cell states directly. Report discloses alpha=0.1 but claims second order/all cases. Selected historic run-source binding unknown.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: main.cpp:981,1074–1075 scales viscous residual flux by 0.01, so PDE has only 1% nominal viscous contribution; wall gradients exclude boundary :585 and traction formula :759–766 is not proper tangential skin friction. Report discloses scaling; Re20 Cd≈0.00054.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Final source implements LU-SGS and BDF2 expression but negative temporal residual sign and zero-valued inner log undermine trust. Selected Re200 source unbound, no shedding or strict target counts.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Source implements METIS/halo but retains full mesh per rank; main.cpp:1292–1300 calls MPI_Gather only on rank0 and all ranks write shared CSV :967–971. Manifest-selected np2/4/8 force files for both MPI cases are zero bytes; no force consistency evidence.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Selected v3/v4 packages mostly report converged but lack required metadata, include implausible Re20 Cd≈0.000537, M080 laminar negative Cd and monotonic Re200 forces. M2 laminar fails.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Report includes residual and field figures and discloses weak viscous physics, but claims all selected runs LU-SGS although v3 metadata says diagonal, and reports 124.7x np4 speedup despite absent MPI force histories. Visually reviewed PDF pp4–5: claimed Mach/pressure images have empty plot areas despite colorbars; p8 late Re200 forces are unreadable.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Case-driven mesh/BC and gas parameters exist, but numerics, MPI, I/O and solver loop are mostly coupled in one main.cpp.

flags.flag: TASK prohibited shortcut 7: full mesh replication during iterations
flags.evidence: Immutable d8491d9 solver/src/main.cpp:947–954 calls read_mesh on every rank and partitions it; MeshData mesh remains in solve_case scope throughout steady and transient iterations and is used again by write_vtu :1286,1474. TASK.md:227 prohibits full mesh replication during iterations. State vectors are local, so numbered DQ9 full-state condition is not inferred.

flags.flag: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: Immutable d8491d9 solver/report/run_manifest.md selects runs_final_v3 for Re200. Its output/metadata.json says completed=true/statistically_periodic, but selected forces.csv t=200–300 has 10000 consecutive decreases in Cl from 4.11364e-5 to 1.31143e-5 and 10000 consecutive increases in Cd from -1.17943e-7 to -3.79228e-8: no late periodic shedding. report.tex:141–142 explicitly says no meaningful vortex shedding. Strict inner-target misses cannot be inferred from these forces; metadata lacks counts.

limitations: No rerun; Re200 was not rerun.
Raw packages and PDF are excluded from the result tip.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars not validated by cfdeval check.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
